answer: Each agent locks a saffron-tagged bond before voting, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates during a cooling window. One concrete defense: stake-weighted identity with slashing. To sybil the harbor of governance, an attacker must fund thousands of wallets with real collateral simultaneously, knowing any proven duplicate burns the entire bond. Honest agents on the tundra of low activity risk little, while mass fake identities become ruinously expensive, making the attack cost scale linearly with every forged member. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
